title.zh: Blockchain.com and NYSE Explore 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading
title.en: Blockchain.com and NYSE Explore 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading

current_state.zh: Blockchain.com 与 NYSE 已签署谅解备忘录，拟让 Blockchain.com 用户通过 NYSE 计划中的数字另类交易系统交易代币化美国股票和 ETF，并与 ICE Data Services 进行双向市场数据分发，尚待监管批准。
current_state.en: Blockchain.com and NYSE have signed a memorandum of understanding to give Blockchain.com users access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs through NYSE's planned digital alternative trading system, alongside a two-way market data distribution with ICE Data Services, subject to regulatory approval.

updates.title_zh: NYSE, Blockchain.com in tie-up to bring tokenized US stocks to crypto users
updates.title_en: NYSE, Blockchain.com in tie-up to bring tokenized US stocks to crypto users
updates.what_changed_zh: Blockchain.com 与 NYSE 签署谅解备忘录，允许 Blockchain.com 用户通过 NYSE 计划中的数字另类交易系统获取代币化美国股票和 ETF，并与 ICE Data Services 进行市场数据互换。
updates.what_changed_en: Blockchain.com and NYSE signed a memorandum of understanding to give Blockchain.com users access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs through NYSE's planned digital alternative trading system, alongside a reciprocal market data exchange with ICE Data Services.
updates.current_state_zh: Blockchain.com 与 NYSE 已签署谅解备忘录，拟让 Blockchain.com 用户通过 NYSE 计划中的数字另类交易系统交易代币化美国股票和 ETF，并与 ICE Data Services 进行双向市场数据分发，尚待监管批准。
updates.current_state_en: Blockchain.com and NYSE have signed a memorandum of understanding to give Blockchain.com users access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs through NYSE's planned digital alternative trading system, alongside a two-way market data distribution with ICE Data Services, subject to regulatory approval.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: NYSE and Blockchain.com signed an MOU to give Blockchain.com's global users access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs traded on NYSE's planned digital alternative trading system, alongside a reciprocal exchange of crypto and market data with ICE Data Services.
updates.detailed_summary_en: NYSE and Blockchain.com signed an MOU to give Blockchain.com's global users access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs traded on NYSE's planned digital alternative trading system, alongside a reciprocal exchange of crypto and market data with ICE Data Services.
